capabilities: assign custom images to core UI icons (vault switcher, help, settings, sidebar toggles)
add, remove, and customize ribbon bar icons with hover images
add, remove, and customize status bar icons with hover images
search and select from Obsidian's icon set
configure image paths relative to the vault root
extras: README covers installation from Community Plugins and GitHub and points to the GitHub repository for issue reporting; no screenshots or troubleshooting section.
problem: Obsidian's UI icons have no built-in way to display custom images on hover.
summary: UI customization plugin that shows a custom image popup when hovering over Obsidian icons such as sidebar toggles, ribbon icons, and status bar icons.
